support_claim: The billing referent Oakfield Logistik GmbH and registry referent HRB 88421 denote the same legal entity, as the register number remained unchanged through the 2023 rebrand and the registry record lists that name for HRB 88421.

propositions.proposition: Oakfield rebranded in 2023 from Oakfield Logistics GmbH to Oakfield Logistik GmbH, and Handelsregister number HRB 88421 did not change during the rebrand.
propositions.relevance: Associates the unchanged registry identifier HRB 88421 (right referent) with the current legal name Oakfield Logistik GmbH (left referent's name).

propositions.proposition: CRM still shows the old English-facing name Oakfield Logistics GmbH despite the 2023 rebrand to Oakfield Logistik GmbH.
propositions.relevance: Documents a naming discrepancy across systems; billing uses the post-rebrand name while CRM retains the prior English-facing name, which bears on cross-source referent alignment.

propositions.proposition: Registry record HRB 88421 lists the registered company name as Oakfield Logistik GmbH, located in Germany, with status active.
propositions.relevance: Directly links the registry referent HRB 88421 to the legal entity name Oakfield Logistik GmbH, matching the billing referent label.

propositions.proposition: Billing invoices record billed_name as Oakfield Logistik GmbH.
propositions.relevance: Confirms that the left referent (billing:Oakfield Logistik GmbH) is the name appearing on invoice billing records.
